text:
lena: Heads-up — staging DAST noise started ~03:20 UTC, ~90 findings across auth-protected endpoints. Failing nightly gate. Anyone digging in?

arjun: I saw alerts. DAST reports lots of open-redirect and broken-auth findings for /oauth/callback and /files/preview. But those endpoints should be behind the staging auth proxy.

pat: Reproduced locally against staging: when the scanner hits some endpoints it gets a 200 with HTML that looks like an error page, scanner interprets as reflected XSS. Could be an auth token refresh latency returning a different HTML blob.

dast-bot: Automated: nightly-dast-run #2023-517: +92 findings. Top rules: reflected-xss, open-redirect, insecure-cors. Context: many responses include 'error: token refresh failed'.

arjun: Quick timeline: we rotated the KMS signing key at 03:15, infra applied RBAC policy change to restrict build:svc -> ephemeral-grant scope at 03:17. Could the token refresh flow be intermittently failing and producing HTML error pages that the scanner misclassifies?

lena: That matches the audit logs I glanced at. infra-bot shows ephemeral grant requests returning 403 between 03:16-03:18, then subsequent successes.

infra-bot: Audit: keystore:ephemeral_grant request from svc-web-refresh at 03:16:43 — 403 denied; 03:17:05 — grant issued. Keystore:get logged at 03:17:06.

pat: So a race window where user sessions hitting the refresh endpoint got a different code path and returned generic HTML with user-injected params. Scanner thinks it's vulnerable.

arjun: Triage proposal: 1) mark findings as false-positive for now with evidence 2) re-run DAST with authenticated session token (simulate refresh) 3) add stricter detection to the DAST harness to ignore 'token refresh failed' pages 4) infra expands keystore audit to include grant context (caller, reason).

lena: I don't want to suppress findings broadly. Let's add a targeted suppression based on response body snippet + staging-only flag. Also open an infra ticket to improve RBAC rollout choreography.

pat: Working on repro steps: curl --location --cookie "staging_session=..." 'https://staging.redwood/oauth/refresh' returns 503 html with 'token refresh failed: grant denied' during the window. I'll attach exact response bodies.

dast-bot: Note: scheduled rerun queued with auth cookie. Will attach raw HTTP traces when done.

arjun: Filed INFRA-2201: "RBAC rollout -> ephemeral grant race causes auth refresh errors". Owner: arjun. cc @infra-oncall. Request: add keystore grant context to audit and implement a 30s backoff in prow job that rotates keys.

lena: Also adding to incident template: include scanner evidence and raw HTTP body for any scan noise suspected to be caused by infra changes.

pat: Rerun finished — most findings vanished when DAST authenticated and replayed refresh flow. Attaching example: 
```
HTTP 200
<html>...error: token refresh failed: grant denied...</html>
```

pat: I'm pushing a small DAST harness patch to ignore responses that contain 'token refresh failed' and staging-only header 'X-Staging-Injected: true'. Will open PR.

arjun: Keep in mind we need to revert ignore once infra mitigates. Add an automated check that will fail if suppression lives more than 7 days.

lena: Good. Assignments: pat -> PR for targeted suppression + evidence bundle; arjun -> INFRA-2201 with mitigation timeline; lena -> add postmortem blurb and suppression expiry policy. security-oncall please monitor overnight.

security-oncall: Acknowledged. Will watch alerts and escalate if suppression still needed after 7d.

lena: Thanks. Once infra adds the keystore grant metadata and we get a safe rotation window we'll remove the temporary suppression and re-run the full nightly DAST.
